The '''Cauldron Nebula''' was a [[Nebula/Legends|nebula]] located within the [[Corva sector/Legends|Corva sector]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. Consisting of seven supergiant blue stars,<ref name="The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia">''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]''</ref> the nebula was home to the [[Eol Sha system/Legends|Eol Sha system]],<ref name="JASB">''[[The Jedi Academy Sourcebook]]''</ref> where a colony was set up in preparation for a [[Mining/Legends|mining]] operation intended to harvest valuable gases from the nebula through the use of [[ramjet mining ship]]s.<ref name="Jedi Search">''[[Jedi Search]]''</ref>

==History==
During his personal vendetta against [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Natasi Daala]] in [[11 ABY/Legends|11 ABY]], renegade [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Padawan/Legends|apprentice]] [[Kyp Durron]] used the [[Sun Crusher]] [[Superweapon/Legends|superweapon]] to ignite the nebula's seven stars in hopes of destroying Daala and the tattered remains of her [[Maw fleet|fleet]]. As a consequence, the Cauldron Nebula was [[Destruction of the Cauldron Nebula|destroyed]] when its stars all went supernova.<ref name="da">[[Dark Apprentice (novel)|''Dark Apprentice'']]</ref>

[[Nebula orchid]]s were named after it.<ref name="The Illustrated Star Wars Universe">''[[The Illustrated Star Wars Universe]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
In the book ''Champions of the Force'', the Cauldron Nebula is mistakenly said to have had only five blue supergiants rather than seven.
